verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only vaguely mentions 'analyze performance' (docs-1), 'agent can analyze your workspace' (docs-32), and scheduled 'deliverability reports' or 'broadcast recaps' (docs-33), but nowhere describes actual metrics dashboards showing opens, clicks, unsubscribes, or conversions broken down per campaign or per automation step over time. No documentation or probe confirms this reporting capability's existence or structure.
